id: 07_Detail Introduction of Light Microscopy microbiology microscope laboratory raqba
title: 显微镜：看得清，也用得安全
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/07_Detail Introduction of Light Microscopy microbiology microscope laboratory raqba.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/07_Detail Introduction of Light Microscopy microbiology microscope laboratory raqba/src.py

points.K4: 看见肉眼看不见的细节
points.K13: 聚光器：把光聚到标本上

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台显微镜旁向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a light microscope on a lab bench and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课认识光学显微镜。
overlay: 显微镜：看得清，也用得安全

shots.scene: 显微镜和一个放大的细胞图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A microscope icon next to an enlarged cell icon. No people.
shots.narration: 从组成、原理讲到类型和局限。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一次走进显微镜室，满桌显微镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into a teaching lab with rows of microscopes on the benches.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次上显微镜实验课。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着显微镜上的旋钮发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at the knobs and lenses of a microscope, puzzled.
shots.narration: 这么多镜头和旋钮，都是干什么的？

shots.scene: 小研走过来，指着显微镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and points at the microscope.
shots.narration: 小研说：先把它认识一遍。

shots.scene: 五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: gears, a light ray, several microscopes, a lab flask and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 本课讲五件事。

shots.scene: 一个人眼图标看不清小点，显微镜下小点变大
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon looking at tiny dots it cannot see, next to a microscope that shows the dots enlarged as cells. No people.
shots.narration: 肉眼看不见的小东西和小生物，

shots.scene: 小研在显微镜前观察
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks into a microscope at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 借显微镜来研究，就叫显微术。

shots.scene: 一个小细胞图标被放大镜框成大细胞
shots.prompt_en: A tiny cell icon grows into a large cell inside a round magnified view. No people.
shots.narration: 显微镜是一种放大物体的仪器，

shots.scene: 显微镜线条图，部件处有空白标注线
shots.prompt_en: A simple line drawing of a microscope with blank label lines pointing to its parts. No people.
shots.narration: 让小东西看起来大得多。

shots.section_title: 看见肉眼看不见的细节
shots.scene: 圆形视野中细胞内部结构逐渐清晰
shots.prompt_en: A round field of view where the internal structures of a cell gradually become sharp. No people.
shots.narration: 原来看不见的细节，
overlay: 看见肉眼看不见的细节

shots.section_title: 看见肉眼看不见的细节
shots.scene: 阿杰凑近目镜，惊讶地睁大眼
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks into the eyepiece and opens his eyes wide in surprise.
shots.narration: 在镜下都能看清。

shots.scene: 光线从底部穿过玻片向上射入镜筒
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of light rays rising from the base, through a slide and up into the microscope tube. No people.
shots.narration: 光学显微镜用可见光照亮标本，

shots.scene: 圆形视野中被照亮并放大的标本
shots.prompt_en: A bright round field of view showing an enlarged, illuminated specimen. No people.
shots.narration: 再把它放大。

shots.scene: 细胞、组织切片、小生物三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a single cell, a tissue section and a small pond organism. No people.
shots.narration: 生物学里常用它看细胞、组织和小生物。

shots.scene: 镜头特写：转换器上一圈物镜
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a microscope nosepiece holding several objective lenses. No people.
shots.narration: 靠近标本的是物镜，

shots.scene: 光线穿过物镜形成第一个放大像
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: light passes through the objective lens and forms a first enlarged image. No people.
shots.narration: 它最先放大，形成标本的初始像。

shots.scene: 四个长短不同的物镜并排
shots.prompt_en: Four objective lenses of different lengths side by side, with color bands and blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 常见的有四个倍数，

shots.scene: 最长的物镜下有一滴油
shots.prompt_en: The longest objective lens dips into a small drop of oil on a slide. No people.
shots.narration: 100倍的是油镜，要加镜油用。

shots.scene: 镜筒顶端的目镜特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the eyepiece at the top of the microscope tube. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛贴近的是目镜，

shots.scene: 示意图：物镜的像在目镜中再次变大
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the image from the objective is enlarged again by the eyepiece. No people.
shots.narration: 把物镜的像再放大一次。

shots.scene: 目镜侧面一个空白小标签
shots.prompt_en: An eyepiece with a small blank ring label on its side. No people.
shots.narration: 大多数目镜是10倍。

shots.scene: 镜座上的亮度旋钮，光从小到大
shots.prompt_en: A brightness dial on the microscope base; the light below the stage grows from dim to bright. No people.
shots.narration: 照明用可见光，亮度可以调，

shots.scene: 小研转动亮度旋钮，视野变清楚
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the brightness dial while looking into the eyepiece.
shots.narration: 调到看得最舒服为止。

shots.scene: 三种灯泡图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Three bulb icons side by side: a tungsten bulb, a halogen bulb and an LED chip. No people.
shots.narration: 光源有钨丝灯、卤素灯和LED。

shots.section_title: 聚光器：把光聚到标本上
shots.scene: 载物台下方的聚光器特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the condenser lens under the microscope stage. No people.
shots.narration: 载物台下面是聚光器，
overlay: 聚光器：把光聚到标本上

shots.section_title: 聚光器：把光聚到标本上
shots.scene: 示意图：散开的光被聚成一束照到标本上
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: spreading light rays are gathered by the condenser into a beam on the specimen. No people.
shots.narration: 把光聚到标本上，照得均匀充足。

shots.scene: 光阑叶片收小和放大
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of an iris diaphragm whose blades open and close. No people.
shots.narration: 聚光器上的光阑，

shots.scene: 视野随光阑变亮变暗
shots.prompt_en: Two round fields of view, one brighter and one dimmer, with a diaphragm icon between them. No people.
shots.narration: 控制照到标本上的光有多少。

shots.scene: 载物台上夹着一块玻片
shots.prompt_en: A glass slide held by clips on the microscope stage. No people.
shots.narration: 载物台用来放玻片，

shots.scene: 小研转动移动旋钮，玻片平移
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the stage control knob and the slide moves sideways.
shots.narration: 前后左右移动，把标本移到物镜下。

shots.scene: 镜身侧面一大一小两个旋钮
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a large coarse focus knob and a small fine focus knob on the side of a microscope. No people.
shots.narration: 大旋钮粗调，小旋钮细调，

shots.scene: 视野从模糊变清晰
shots.prompt_en: A round field of view going from blurry to sharp. No people.
shots.narration: 把标本调得清清楚楚。

shots.scene: 光线经过透镜发生弯折
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of light rays bending as they pass through a convex lens. No people.
shots.narration: 它的原理是折射和放大。

shots.scene: 光穿过标本时弯折，细胞轮廓显现
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of light rays bending as they pass through a thin specimen, revealing cell outlines. No people.
shots.narration: 光穿过标本时发生折射，

shots.scene: 细胞轮廓在视野中显现
shots.prompt_en: Cell outlines appear clearly in a round field of view. No people.
shots.narration: 标本的结构就显现出来。

shots.scene: 光路图：物镜成像，目镜再放大
shots.prompt_en: A light path diagram: the objective forms an enlarged image, then the eyepiece enlarges it again toward an eye icon. No people.
shots.narration: 物镜成放大的像，目镜再放大给你看。

shots.scene: 物镜和目镜图标之间一个乘号
shots.prompt_en: An objective lens icon, a multiplication sign and an eyepiece icon. No people.
shots.narration: 总放大倍数，是两者相乘。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白本子上做乘法
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes a simple multiplication on a blank notebook page and smiles.
shots.narration: 40倍物镜配10倍目镜，就是400倍。

shots.scene: 亮背景上的深色染色细胞
shots.prompt_en: A round field of view with a bright background and dark stained cells. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的是明场显微镜，

shots.scene: 染色瓶旁边的染色玻片
shots.prompt_en: A stained slide next to blank staining bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 亮背景暗标本，适合看染色样本。

shots.scene: 透明细胞在视野中显出明暗轮廓
shots.prompt_en: Transparent living cells shown with enhanced light and dark outlines in a field of view. No people.
shots.narration: 相差显微镜让透明的活细胞，

shots.scene: 未染色细胞从几乎看不见到清楚
shots.prompt_en: Unstained cells change from almost invisible to clearly outlined. No people.
shots.narration: 不染色也看得清。

shots.scene: 暗背景上发绿光的细胞结构
shots.prompt_en: A dark field of view with glowing green cell structures. No people.
shots.narration: 荧光显微镜看的是会发光的标记，

shots.scene: 荧光染料小分子贴到细胞结构上
shots.prompt_en: Small glowing tag icons attach to specific structures in a cell diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 用荧光染料或荧光蛋白标出目标。

shots.scene: 一束细光一层层扫描标本
shots.prompt_en: A thin beam scans a specimen layer by layer in a diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 共聚焦显微镜用激光逐层扫描，

shots.scene: 多层图像叠成一个立体细胞
shots.prompt_en: Several image slices stack into a three-dimensional cell model. No people.
shots.narration: 拼出细致的三维图像。

shots.scene: 细胞和微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of cells, tissue and microbes under a magnifying circle. No people.
shots.narration: 科研里，看细胞、组织和微生物；

shots.scene: 医院检验室里的显微镜和血涂片图标
shots.prompt_en: A microscope in a hospital clinical lab next to a blood smear slide icon. No people.
shots.narration: 医学上，查血细胞、病原和组织病变。

shots.scene: 晶体和纳米材料图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a crystal lattice and nanoparticle dots under a microscope. No people.
shots.narration: 材料学里，看材料和晶体结构；

shots.scene: 流水线上的零件被放大检查
shots.prompt_en: An industrial part on a conveyor belt inspected under a magnifier. No people.
shots.narration: 工厂里，检查产品和零件质量。

shots.scene: 两个靠得很近的点在视野中糊成一个
shots.prompt_en: Two very close dots in a field of view blur together into one. No people.
shots.narration: 光学显微镜的分辨率有上限，

shots.scene: 一把尺子图标上标出很小的长度
shots.prompt_en: A ruler icon with a tiny marked length and a light wave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 小于约200纳米的结构看不清。

shots.scene: 一层清楚，上下层模糊
shots.prompt_en: A thick specimen in a field of view: one layer is sharp while the layers above and below are blurry. No people.
shots.narration: 景深有限，一张图只清楚一层，

shots.scene: 立体细胞图标打了个问号
shots.prompt_en: A three-dimensional cell icon with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 立体结构难一次看全。

shots.scene: 染色瓶和固定液瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank stain bottle and a blank fixative bottle next to a slide. No people.
shots.narration: 标本常要染色或固定，

shots.scene: 活细胞变成固定后的细胞
shots.prompt_en: A living cell icon changes into a fixed, still cell icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这可能改变它原来的样子。

shots.scene: 灰淡的标本几乎看不清
shots.prompt_en: A pale, low-contrast specimen barely visible in a field of view. No people.
shots.narration: 有些标本对比度太低，看不清楚。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向一台大型电子显微镜的剪影
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to the silhouette of a large electron microscope.
shots.narration: 下一课，认识电子显微镜。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现物镜、目镜、光源图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of an objective lens, an eyepiece and a light bulb.
shots.narration: 物镜目镜相乘，就是总倍数。

shots.scene: 四种显微镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Four microscope icons: bright field, phase contrast, fluorescence and confocal. No people.
shots.narration: 明场、相差、荧光、共聚焦，各有所长。

shots.scene: 科研、诊断、材料、质检四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a cell, a clinical slide, a crystal and an industrial part. No people.
shots.narration: 科研、诊断、材料、质检都用得上。

shots.scene: 分辨率、景深、制片、对比度四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: two blurred dots, a blurry layer, a stain bottle and a pale specimen. No people.
shots.narration: 但分辨率、景深、对比度都有局限。

shots.scene: 欣欣在坐在显微镜前的阿杰旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the young male student, who sits at a microscope.
shots.narration: 认识显微镜，看清微世界，下次见！
